projects.title: SIGNAL: Socioeconomic-geographic Intelligence for Grid Net-load Analytics and Learning
projects.summary: Open-source short-term net-load forecasting that accounts for behind-the-meter solar, batteries and electric vehicles.
projects.description: A four-year project funded by the CEC to address the rapid growth of behind-the-meter distributed energy resources (solar PV, battery storage and electric vehicles) that operate invisibly to grid operators. Led by CalPlug with LBNL, UC San Diego and Derapi, Inc., together with California utility partners, the project builds a standardized data workflow, a multi-horizon forecasting model from five minutes to day-ahead, and a multi-stage validation that includes a community-scale demonstration at Laguna Woods Village and utility pilot testing at selected substations.
projects.image_alt: Simplified diagram of the SIGNAL forecasting workflow

projects.title: AI-TES: AI-Driven Framework for Rapid Performance Prediction and Operation Optimization of Sensible Thermal Energy Storage Systems
projects.summary: An AI/ML framework that predicts and controls sensible thermal energy storage performance much faster than CFD simulation.
projects.description: Sensible thermal energy storage (TES) systems are traditionally designed and controlled with computationally costly heat-transfer and CFD simulations, which hinders rapid design iteration and real-time control. This research introduces an AI/ML framework that accelerates TES performance prediction and supports real-time control of system operation, in support of strategies such as demand response.
projects.image_alt: Diagram of thermal energy storage technologies

projects.title: Edge Data Center Smart Retrofit
projects.summary: Economical retrofit strategies that coordinate cooling controls and server workloads to cut energy use in small edge data centers.
projects.description: Small-scale edge data centers often rely on less efficient building HVAC systems and are overlooked in the data center sector. This project demonstrates cost-effective, easy-to-deploy retrofit strategies for them, integrating digital air-cooling controls with real-time thermal management, and server virtualization with dynamic workload consolidation.
projects.image_alt: Illustration of edge data centers in a city

projects.title: Occupancy-based Lighting PPL Smart Management
projects.summary: A sensor-based building management system that controls lighting and HVAC from real-time occupancy detection, demonstrated at a UCI campus building.
projects.description: This project develops a sensor-based building management system that integrates dynamic lighting and HVAC control through real-time occupancy detection, using multi-signal data fusion and behavioral learning algorithms. Over a 24-month period including a demonstration at a UCI campus building, the plug-and-play system will show deployment feasibility and scalability, supporting custom measure development for California investor-owned utilities.
projects.image_alt: Diagram of the occupancy-based lighting and HVAC control system
